title: Final Temperature
description: Essential Criteria: The final temperature T_f must be correctly derived as T_f = sqrt(T_1 T_2).

title: Work Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The work delivered W must be correctly expressed as W = NC(T_1 + T_2 - 2sqrt(T_1 T_2)).

title: Carnot Relation
description: Important Criteria: The relationship derived from the Carnot engine must be correctly applied, showing dQ_1/T_1 = -dQ_2/T_2.

title: Integration Steps
description: Important Criteria: The integration steps leading to the final temperature must be clearly shown and correctly executed.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The conservation of energy principle must be correctly applied to derive the expression for work.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common sign errors in the application of the Carnot relation.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that units are consistent throughout the calculations, particularly in energy and temperature.
